news.title: Leslie Ain McClure to be Honored for Work in Social Justice by Association for Women in Mathematics
news.summary_en: Leslie Ain McClure, Ph.D., will receive the 2027 Mary and Alfie Gray Award for Social Justice from the Association for Women in Mathematics (AWM) at the Joint Mathematics Meetings in Chicago, in January 2027.

news.title: SLU Clinicians Will Offer Free Psychological Services to St. Louis City Residents
news.summary_en: St. Louisans seeking affordable mental health care can take the first step by getting a free assessment at Saint Louis University’s Psychological Services Center. Psychological assessments help determine cognitive, educational, emotional and behavioral difficulties for both children and adults and can result in diagnoses and recommended treatment plans tailored to each individual. news.title: SLU, NGA to Host Geo-Resolution Conference September 10
news.summary_en: Saint Louis University and the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency will co-host the 2026 Geo-Resolution conference, "Securing the Future with Geospatial," at SLU's Busch Student Center Sept. 10.
